independent_renderer.purpose: Secondary renderer sanity only, not Wine/source fidelity evidence.

limitations: No remaining native device-quantization or unequal-axis raster correction established.
PDF math/resource preservation and qpdf/text checks are not fidelity passes.
The half-alpha control changes color/coverage and loses 31 visible glyph cells; it is not a valid fidelity candidate or a transparency-conformance pass.
Only original axis controls; no new actual-corpus or runtime parity claim.
Full-opacity equality does not prove that transparency groups are universally ignored.
Independent MuPDF rendering changes under isolation; it is not the requested source of truth.
